title: MemeArena: Automating Context-Aware Unbiased Evaluation of Harmfulness Understanding for Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the deviation of model rankings produced by individual judge agents compared to an ideal joint-voting baseline using the Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG) metric. It specifically measures 'self-evaluation bias' by observing if judge models preferentially assign higher Elo ratings to their own generated analyses.

Randomizing the order of the target models' answers (Model A vs. Model B) in the multi-view fusion and judgment prompts to ensure the LLM judge's pairwise comparisons are not skewed by the presentation sequence of the inputs.
